privacy.ai_training_note: Customer data (audio, transcripts, clinical documentation) is anonymized within 90 days per HIPAA de-identification and GDPR anonymization standards. Dragon Copilot's AI/ML models are trained SOLELY on this anonymized data. Raw PHI is never used to train models. Direct quote: 'Dragon Copilot's AI/ML models are trained solely on anonymized data.' The vendor also states data is 'never used to train large language models' (referring to the underlying base LLMs); model improvement is limited to Dragon Copilot's own clinical AI/ML components. Human review of raw customer data occurs only for support tickets and annotation of anonymized training sets.
privacy.data_region: US (operations + research in US), Canada (operations in Canada), UK (operations in UK), France/Ireland/Belgium (operations in France, research in EU), Germany/Austria/Netherlands/Switzerland (operations in Germany, research in EU). Data never leaves its geography.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256; Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) via Microsoft 365 Customer Key supported

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.3 with AES-256; audio additionally encrypted with RSA 4096-bit key at capture before TLS wrapping

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Yes - third-party periodic penetration testing; internal and external scanning; red team approach. Quote: 'Microsoft HLS uses a third-party service to conduct periodic penetration testing, and conducts internal and external scans to identify and address potential vulnerabilities.'

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: Microsoft self-hosted MSRC program (not HackerOne or Bugcrowd); uses Intigriti for award delivery. Dragon Copilot is part of Microsoft Azure/M365 scope. Awards up to $250,000 USD. URL: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/msrc/bounty

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) with OpenID Connect; SSO and token-based access; two-factor authentication required for all administrative access via Secure Admin Workstation (SAW)

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: Full audit logs (date, time, user, event type, IP, success/failure) stored in Azure Application Insights and ingested into Azure Sentinel SIEM. Logs are read-only.

security.name: High availability
security.value: Active/active Azure deployment; guaranteed 99.9% uptime; 10 US data centers; data replicated between two data centers; automatic failover

security.name: Secure development lifecycle
security.value: Microsoft SDL + BSIMM; Attack Surface Analyzer (ASA) used on each release

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Audio, transcript, and flowsheet data retained up to 90 days. Anonymization occurs within 90 days. Data purged via Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management on contract expiry.

products.name: Dragon Copilot for Physicians
products.data_scope: PHI: audio recordings, transcripts, AI-generated clinical notes. Processes voice of clinician and patient during encounters. Data stays in customer's geography. HIPAA BAA covers this product.
products.notes: Available on iOS (mobile), Windows (desktop), browser (web), and embedded in EHR. Rebranded from DAX Copilot in March 2025.

products.name: Dragon Copilot for Nurses
products.data_scope: PHI: audio, transcripts, flowsheet values. Currently US-only; data never leaves the US. Embedded in EHR mobile apps via Entra ID mapping.
products.notes: US-only as of June 2026. Captures flowsheet rows and narrative summaries. Separate embedded EHR experience.

products.name: Dragon Copilot for Radiologists
products.data_scope: PHI: radiology encounter audio and report drafts. Integrates with PowerScribe One for reporting workflow.
products.notes: Combines Dragon Medical One voice dictation with ambient AI; PowerScribe One integration.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise subscription per clinician per month (~$369-$830/month per provider depending on volume; one-time setup fee ~$650-$700). Pricing not publicly listed; requires sales quote. Available on Microsoft Azure Marketplace.
compare.data_residency: Per-geography data residency enforced: US, Canada, UK, France (EU), Germany (EU). Data never crosses geographic boundaries.

flags: ISO 27001 certification for Dragon Copilot product is listed as 'pending' as of June 2026 FAQ; Azure infrastructure itself holds ISO 27001 but the product-specific cert is not yet issued.

AI/ML model training uses anonymized customer data: this is HIPAA-compliant de-identification, not raw PHI. Healthcare procurement teams should review the DPA and Service Specific Terms for opt-out or data-use restriction options.
Nursing functionality is currently US-only; international expansion planned but not confirmed timeline.
Pricing is not publicly disclosed; enterprise sales engagement required with multi-month implementation timelines (3-6 months).
